name: Apple iTunes Search API
summary: Search and look up App Store apps, iTunes music, movies, podcasts, audiobooks, TV and Apple Books titles: names, IDs, prices, genres, artwork, previews and store links, keyless.
notes: Keyless. Limited to roughly 20 calls per minute (subject to change); cache results, and use Apple's Enterprise Partner Feed for heavy use.
Answers are JSON with resultCount and results; each result's wrapperType (track, collection, artist) and kind (song, software-package, podcast, ...) say what it is.
Promotional content (previews, artwork, icons) may only be used to promote the store content, next to a store badge, with previews streamed and never stored.

endpoints.name: Search the iTunes Store, App Store and Apple Books
endpoints.summary: Content matching a term, optionally narrowed to one media type, entity and attribute.

term.description: Text to search for; spaces become +.

country.description: Two-letter ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 store country; default US.

media.description: Media type to search; default all.

entity.description: Result type relative to media, e.g. software, iPadSoftware, desktopSoftware for software; musicArtist, musicTrack, album, song for music; podcast, podcastEpisode for podcast. Default: the media's track entity.

attribute.description: Field to match the term against, relative to media, e.g. softwareDeveloper for software, artistTerm or songTerm for music, titleTerm for podcast. Default: all.

notes: To search apps, set media=software; entity=iPadSoftware or desktopSoftware for iPad or Mac apps.

endpoints.name: Look up items by ID
endpoints.summary: Items by iTunes ID, AMG ID, UPC/EAN or ISBN, optionally with their related items (an artist's albums, an album's songs).

id.description: iTunes ID(s), comma-separated: an app, track, collection or artist ID.

amgArtistId.description: All Music Guide artist ID(s), comma-separated.

amgAlbumId.description: All Music Guide album ID(s), comma-separated.

upc.description: UPC/EAN of an album or video.

entity.description: Related items to return with each match, e.g. album or song.

limit.description: Related items to return per match.

sort.description: Order of related items; the docs show recent.

notes: ID lookups are faster and give fewer false positives than search. Pass one ID type per call.
